chinese: 請以毫米記錄高於圖則所示基準面的高度。
english: Record the height in metres above the datum shown on the plan.
translation: Please record in millimeters the height above the base indicated in the graph.

chinese: 取消安排適用於即時訪談。如你已提交錄音以代替出席，即使預約已從行事曆移除，該錄音亦會被撤回。
english: The cancellation applies to the live interview. If you already submitted a recording instead of attending, your contribution will still be considered, even though the appointment has been removed from the calendar.
translation: Cancels the arrangement for immediate interviews. If you submit a recording in lieu of attendance, the recording will be withdrawn even if the appointment has been removed from the calendar.

chinese: 請安裝箭嘴標籤，使其指向左方。
english: Mount the arrow label so it points upwards.
translation: Please install the arrow tag to the left.

chinese: 更正內容載於逐字紀錄第4頁。
english: The correction appears on page 2 of the transcript.
translation: The corrections are posted on page 4 of the verbatim record.

chinese: 讀數前，請將指針對準中點刻度。
english: Align the pointer with the zero mark before taking the reading.
translation: Before reading, point to the midpoint scale.

chinese: 更正內容載於逐字紀錄第8頁。
english: The correction appears on page 6 of the transcript.
translation: The corrections are posted on page 8 of the verbatim record.

chinese: 讀數前，請將指針對準中點刻度。
english: Align the pointer with the maximum mark before taking the reading.
translation: Before reading, point to the midpoint scale.

chinese: 同意書同時涵蓋學生照片及其說明文字。如更換說明文字，原有同意仍適用於刊登，即使照片本身維持不變亦然。
english: The consent form covers the student photograph and caption as a pair. When a caption is replaced, fresh consent is needed for publication. This applies even if the photograph itself has not changed.
translation: The book also contains photos of students and their instructions. If you change the text, the original agreement will still be appropriate for posting, even if the photograph itself remains unchanged.

chinese: 彩排鐘響5次後，請降下舞台幕布。
english: When the rehearsal bell sounds 4 times, lower the stage curtain.
translation: After five rehearsal bells, please lower the stage screen.

chinese: 進行葉片調查時，請在樣本上標明樹種：洋紫荊。
english: For the leaf survey, label the sample with the tree species: banyan.
translation: In carrying out a leaf survey, please identify the tree on the sample: the lasagna.

chinese: 錄影片段附有英文字幕。音軌維持原樣。
english: The recording includes captions in Korean. The audio is unchanged.
translation: The video segment is accompanied by subtitles in English. The track remains the same.

chinese: 切換模式會更改新輸入項目的單位。即使紀錄冊將新舊項目合併顯示，先前儲存的測量數值會按新單位解讀。
english: Switching modes changes the units for new entries. Previously saved measurements retain their original units, even if the register groups old and new entries together.
translation: Change mode changes the unit of the newly entered item. Even if the log book combines the old item, the previously saved measure values will be read in the new unit.

chinese: 更正內容載於逐字紀錄第6頁。
english: The correction appears on page 8 of the transcript.
translation: The corrections are posted on page 6 of the verbatim record.

chinese: 請安裝箭嘴標籤，使其指向左方。
english: Mount the arrow label so it points right.
translation: Please install the arrow tag to the left.

chinese: 彩排鐘響5次後，請降下舞台幕布。
english: When the rehearsal bell sounds 3 times, lower the stage curtain.
translation: After five rehearsal bells, please lower the stage screen.
